context_for_next_testing_agent: Character & Voice Refactor complete. Key changes: 1) Audition section moved to TOP of Characters page, Characters section BELOW. 2) 30 voice cards grid with Play Sample buttons for FREE preview. 3) Category filter badges (All, Narrator, Deep Voice, Energetic, Calm, Dramatic). 4) Custom Audition panel for PAID custom dialogue (costs audition credits). 5) Test Voice button REMOVED from character cards - only Edit and Delete remain. 6) Edit character dialog allows changing name and voice. Backend has 3 key endpoints: GET /api/voices/samples (status), GET /api/voices/preview/{voice_id} (FREE), POST /api/tts/audition (PAID).
